sources.quote: 5X Reward Points ... will be capped at 10,000 Reward Points per calendar month
Post that, every Rs.100 spent will accrue 1 Reward Point
Cash Advance, Balance Transfer, Encash, Flexipay and Offline Fuel transaction (5172, 5541, 5983, 5542) are not included
Exclusive partner transactions will have a monthly cap of 10,000 point.

sources.doc: SimplyCLICK T&C booklet (Jul 2026), Exclusive Online Partner table (page 13)
sources.quote: Tata CLiQ 20th March, 2026; IGP 10th February, 2025; BookMyShow 15th September, 2015
Utility Bill Payments done ... on SBI Card website/ mobile app will not accrue 5X Reward Points.

examples.title: Rs 3,000 online purchase on Amazon (5X)
examples.why: 5X on other online spends: 30 x 5 = 150. The 10,000 RP monthly 5X cap equals Rs2,00,000 of 5X spend, so the cap counts the Rs3,000 spent.

examples.title: Rs 10,000 on Cleartrip (exclusive partner, 10X)
examples.why: 10X on exclusive partners (Cleartrip): 100 x 10 = 1,000, within the 10X monthly cap of 10,000 RP (MITC booklet g, k). Not engine-checkable: affiliate-channel bookings do not earn 10X.
examples.not_checkable_reason: D14a: 10X on Cleartrip excludes affiliate-channel bookings (T&C 11.1(i)); the booking channel is not in the context, so the 10X rule stays info.

examples.title: Rs 5,000 online after the 5X cap is used
examples.why: The 5X cap (10,000 RP = Rs2,00,000 of 5X spend) is used; standard points continue after it (MITC g): 50 x 1 = 50.

examples.title: Rs 2,000 on BookMyShow (exclusive partner, 10X)
examples.why: T&C (f)/(g): 10X Reward Points on online spends with exclusive partners; BookMyShow is a partner since 15 Sep 2015 (partner table). 20 x 10 = 200 RP, inside the 10,000 RP monthly 10X cap (MITC g, k), which is Rs1,00,000 of 10X spend, so the cap counts the Rs2,000.

examples.title: Rs 2,000 on Tata CLiQ before it became a partner (5X)
examples.why: Partner table: Tata CLiQ is a 10X partner from 20th March, 2026. On 15 Feb 2026 it is an other online spend: T&C (g) 5X = 20 x 5 = 100 RP, counted in the 5X cap (Rs2,00,000 of spend).

examples.title: Rs 2,000 on Tata CLiQ after it became a partner (10X)
examples.why: Partner table: Tata CLiQ 10X from 20th March, 2026. 20 x 10 = 200 RP, counted in the 10X cap (Rs1,00,000 of spend).

examples.title: Rs 2,000 paid on the SBI Card app (no 5X)
examples.why: T&C Reward Point (c): utility bill payments on the SBI Card website/mobile app do not accrue 5X; standard 1 RP per Rs100 applies: 20 x 1 = 20 RP, nothing counted in the 5X cap.

research_notes.cardpipeline_says: 10,000 RP per month on the 10X tier.
research_notes.issuer_says: T&C state the 10,000 cap for the 5X tier only. No cap is stated for 10X, so no boundary example. Superseded: the MITC booklet (g), (k) states the 10X cap (10,000 RP a month); modelled since WP7 round 1.
Matches ("every Rs.100 spent will accrue 1 RP" after the cap). How a transaction that crosses the cap is split is not stated, so no boundary example.

research_notes.cardpipeline_says: 10 partners incl. Apollo, BookMyShow, Dominos, IGP, Myntra, Netmeds, Yatra, GyFTR, Tata CLiQ.
research_notes.issuer_says: The booklet lists partners as images, so the list could not be read as text. Cleartrip, Yatra and GyFTR are named in the text. Superseded 2026-11-06: the rendered product page lists them as text (see the Card-data note).

research_notes.item: WP7 r1: cap units in examples 002 and 004
research_notes.issuer_says: MITC booklet (g): 5X and 10X are each capped at 10,000 RP a month, then standard points continue. Modelled as eligible-spend caps (Rs2,00,000 for 5X, Rs1,00,000 for 10X) with base_rate, so the examples state the 5X cap in rupees. Points unchanged.

research_notes.item: Card-data 2026-11-06: exclusive partner list and dates
research_notes.cardpipeline_says: One 10X rule for 10 partners, effective 2023-01-01, info (affiliate channel, MID, online flag).
research_notes.issuer_says: Product page (rendered) lists the partners as text: Apollo 24x7, BookMyShow, Cleartrip, Dominos, IGP, Myntra, Netmeds, Swiggy, Yatra, Gyftr, Tata Cliq. T&C page 13 table gives each partner's start date (read from the rendered page). Affiliate exclusion only for Cleartrip (h) and Yatra (l); GyFTR 10X only on the SBI SimplyCLICK GyFTR portal (p). Split into dated earn rules for BookMyShow/Netmeds, Domino's/Myntra, IGP, Tata CLiQ; Apollo 24|7 (directory 'apollo' also covers Apollo Pharmacy/Hospitals), Cleartrip, Yatra, GyFTR stay info with depends_on_txn_attribute.
